name: handleAppointmentScheduling
shortDescription: Manages the end-to-end workflow for scheduling, rescheduling, or canceling appointments, including availability checks and notifications.
description:
Overview

Orchestrates the process of scheduling, rescheduling, or canceling appointments. This includes checking doctor availability, updating appointment statuses, sending confirmation emails, and dispatching webhook notifications for significant events.

Intended use

Called by the patient portal or doctor dashboard UI when a user (patient, doctor, or admin) initiates an appointment action (schedule, reschedule, cancel).

Logic

  1. Validate input parameters (e.g., patientProfileId, doctorProfileId, appointmentDate, appointmentTime, status).
  2. For scheduling/rescheduling:
    • Retrieve DoctorProfile to check availabilityJson for conflicts. Return an error if the doctor is unavailable.
    • Create or update the Appointment record using ctx.data.create or ctx.data.update.
    • Send an appointment confirmation/update email to the patient and doctor using ctx.email.send_template.
  3. For cancellation:
    • Retrieve the existing Appointment record.
    • Update the Appointment status to 'cancelled' using ctx.data.update.
    • Send a cancellation email to the patient and doctor using ctx.email.send_template.
  4. Send a webhook notification to external endpoints about the appointment event (booking, cancellation, reschedule) using ctx.webhook.send.
  5. Audit-log the appointment action using ctx.audit.log.
  6. Return the updated Appointment record.

Entities

  • Appointment
  • DoctorProfile
  • PatientProfile

External Services

  • OutboundWebhook
